item.title: Physics Department Softball Social Gathering
item.description: On Sunday, June 28, members of the Department of Physics gathered for a social event centered around a softball tournament. Although we were eliminated in the preliminary round, individual efforts led to us successfully scoring two runs. We would like to thank everyone who participated, those who stepped in to help as substitute players, and the organizers who planned and managed the event.

item.title: Watching Carp-Orix interleague game
item.description: On Saturday, June 6th, a group of about a dozen of us went on a field trip to Mazda Stadium to watch the interleague game between the Hiroshima Carp and the Orix Buffaloes. The Carp maintained the lead from the beginning, but in the eighth inning they were in danger of being overtaken. However, some great plays by Taka and Nahara helped turn the tide, and the Carp won 7-4. After the game, we had a celebratory meal.

item.title: Shonosuke Takeshita won the Student Presentation Award of the Physical Society of JAPAN at 2025 (80th) Annual Meeting!
item.description:
We are happy to congratulate Shonosuke Takeshita, a doctoral student in our group!

He was awarded as the best student presenter at the Physical Society of Japan 2025 (80th) Annual Meeting .

item.title: Dr. Sakai gave a Seminar talk at joint seminar between Taiwan QCD Meeting and The High Energy Theory Group, Institute of Physics, Academia Sinica, Taiwan
item.description: We are happy to congratulate that Dr. Sakai, a staff in our group, gave a seminar talk at joint seminar between Taiwan QCD Meeting and The High Energy Theory Group, Institute of Physics, Academia Sinica, Taiwan! He won the best poster Award at Symmetry 2023 International Conference .

item.title: Masahiko Taniguchi won the best poster presentation award at Symmetry 2023 International Conference
item.description: We are happy to congratulate Masahiko Taniguchi, a doctoral student in our group! He won the best poster Award at Symmetry 2023 International Conference .

item.title: Dr. Yusuke Shimizu's paper got most cite paper at PTEP
item.description: We are happy to congratulate Dr. Yusuke Shimizu, a staff in our group! He and his collaborators’ paper got the most cite paper at Progress of Theoretical and Experimental Physics (PTEP) journal.

item.title: Dr. Sakai won the Flash Talk Award at QM2022!
item.description: We are happy to congratulate Dr. Sakai, a postdoc in our group! She won the Flash Talk Award at the Quark Matter (QM) 2022 (29th International Conference on Ultra-relativistic Nucleus-Nucleus Collisions) international conference.
